A big EDIT / LIVE switch sits beside the logo. EDIT is the Stutter you know: drop a file, shape the fill, drag it out. LIVE stutters whatever plays through the channel, with no latency, and it sounds exactly like the fill you built in EDIT - every preset, GRID, RAMP, COMPLEX row, KEY, filter and fade. AUTO (the default): play the song and the fills come by themselves, on its bars - one every 1, 2, 4 or 8 bars, BARS long, at the END of the phrase (landing on the next downbeat) or at its START. With BARS as long as EVERY it never stops. HOLD and ONE-SHOT play it by hand: the HOLD pad, the six macro slots as pads (an empty slot plays a ready sound), MIDI notes C3 to F3 for pads 1 to 6 and any other note for the panel (VST3 - route a MIDI track to Stutter), or the Live Trigger parameter as automation. CATCH lands a press on the next 1/16, beat or bar, so it is always in time. When the song stops, LIVE lets go. In the AU version the pads take no MIDI; the pads on screen and the automation work. 1.7.4 - FIX: the plugin window no longer goes black when the mouse is over it. Yesterday's update hid the page whenever another window seemed to sit on top, and it took the plugin's own file-drop layer for one (Live, Studio One) - now only a real window in front counts. 1.7.3 - COMPLEX sounds like the sample again: after a SLOW or RISE step, the steps that followed came out slightly dull, as if a low-pass were on (up to -6 dB at 15 kHz). PLAY, ROLL and STUCK now play the source exactly, and pitched slices and the tape steps keep their top end too - in COMPLEX and in the GRID. Filters and fades stay where you set them, in ADVANCED and EXTRAS. 1.7.2 - With the plugin window minimised, closed or behind another window (in FL Studio, the mixer), the place where it sat no longer catches the mouse: the DAW's own buttons and faders there can be clicked again. 1.7.1 - PLAY LOCK: the new padlock key next to RESULT keeps the preview playing in a loop, so you can flip through presets and hear each one at once - every change starts the loop again from the top (on the next bar with ON BAR while the song plays). DICE is now a die, and the COMPLEX steps get their own row, so the FADE IN knob no longer covers them. 1.7.0 - COMPLEX: a new key at the end of the GRID row turns the fill into a row of steps, like FL's Chop > Complex. Each step is ROLL (with its own grid), STUCK, PLAY, SLOW, RISE (tape stop and spin-up), REV or GAP, and can carry its own pitch. FOLLOW reads on through the sample, HOLD restarts every step, HITS cuts on the transients. Click a step to edit, split, join, copy or delete it; DICE rolls a new row. 40 new presets: COMPLEX CATCHES, TAPE, GLITCH, BUILDS and PSYCHEDELIC, TREMOLO GATES and more PSYCHEDELIC. FADE OUT and STEREO AUTO now have a RANGE: drag the handle at the end of the ring to set where the sweep ends. 1.6.9 - the knobs and the popover lists now work on older Macs too (macOS before Big Sur): on those Macs the page could stop loading and the lists did not open. 1.6.8 - STEREO now works on mono samples (most one-shots are mono): the fill comes out in stereo and the hits jump left and right as they should. FADE OUT and STEREO are real arc knobs with their AUTO under them. 1.6.6 - On Windows the mouse wheel now works inside the plugin: the preset list scrolls, and knobs and values turn with the wheel. 1.6.5 - When two windows of the plugin open together (two instances in one project), the second no longer stays white. The plugin carries its own fonts, so it looks the same with no internet connection, and the small labels are larger and easier to read. 1.6.4 - EXTRAS now opens above the RESULT button, so you can tweak and hear the result without closing it. 1.6.3 - FILTER RANGE: with HIGH PASS / LOW PASS AUTO on, drag the handle at the end of the ring to set where the sweep stops (the readout shows the range, e.g. 100 > 2.0k). Double-click it to go back to the full sweep. 1.6.2 - FILTER AUTO: HIGH PASS and LOW PASS can now sweep across the fill, like FADE OUT and STEREO AUTO - the knob is where it starts, UP / DOWN sweep it to the end. A new FILTER LIN / EXP switch in EXTRAS shapes the sweep. 1.6.1 - In Ableton Live the plugin now fills its window: with Auto-Scale Plug-In Window on and a screen scaled above 100 %, the interface no longer sits in a corner with a white band, and it refits when you move it to a monitor with a different scale. 1.6.0 - FILTER: a HIGH PASS and a LOW PASS in EXTRAS, baked into the rendered fill (24 dB/oct, all the way to the end = off). Saved with the project and the presets. Double-click on PITCH now resets it to 0.

The meters draw at about 60 frames a second on any screen (a 144 Hz monitor used to get 144), the LED bars and peak caps are drawn once and reused, and when nothing is playing the panels rest until something moves. 1.3.25 - The yellow 10 dB rules and the fainter 5 dB lines are back over the Spectrogram's bars, and with them the reference lines, the live average and the readout under the pointer - 1.3.23 had stopped drawing them in BARS. 1.3.24 - Settings live on their panels, the way the classic hardware lays them out: the spectrogram's gear opens the Spectrum Analyser settings, a new gear on the level meters opens the Level Meter settings, and the vectorscope's gear the Goniometer settings (in WAVES the spectrogram's gear is the FFT's own settings). the FFT's Routing - Stereo, Mid, Side, Left, Right - is in WAVES' settings. A large Block Size no longer leaves the WAVES curve standing still: it moves at least 24 times a second, with the same levels. The analyser and the level meters stand on whole screen pixels like the classic: every LED the same size at any window size, the plot growing a whole LED at a time as the window is resized. MAX PEAK and MAX RMS are readings now, not buttons. 1.3.23 - In WAVES the spectrogram's gear opens the FFT's own settings: Type, Window, Block Size, Overlap, Avg Time, a second spectrum, Filled display, Anti-alias, Align 0 dB, Offset, Smooth, Freq and Range limits and Slope, with the FFT's choices and a DEFAULT that brings back the FFT's factory mode - so whoever comes from the FFT analyser sets it the way they know (in BARS the gear is the classic Setup, as before). The vectorscope draws like a beam: threads of light that are bright where the signal moves slowly and faint where it jumps, with a soft glow. A right click on a zone name under the spectrum solos that zone alone; right click it again for the whole mix. 1.3.22 - Stability: the RONE Analyzer Bridge lets go of its fonts safely when a DAW unloads it (FL Studio could crash on exit after its window had been open), ignores empty audio blocks, and turns a NaN coming from a plug-in before it into silence instead of passing it on. The maximum is a thin line over the curve instead of a second filled body. 1.3.18 - NOTE: the note under the mix - the fundamental of the bass or the kick - reads under the reference strip, with its octave, hertz and cents. Plus fixes from a check of every button: All plugins leaves My presets, the star on a MIDI file stars it instead of loading it, and a path that is too long is named. 1.0.2 (Mac) - the title bar moves the window again, and the menu bar icon is the RONE mark. 1.0.1 - The Ring: the line that confirms a load stays on one line when the plugin has a picture. 1.0.0 - THE RING: hold a mouse button inside your DAW and a wheel of your plugins opens right under the mouse, with their real pictures. Point at one and let go: it loads onto the selected track. Eight slices per ring, folders open an outer ring, the wheel turns to your next ring, and typing searches all your plugins. Open it with Mouse 4 or 5, the wheel button, a long press of the right button (a quick right click still opens its menu), Ctrl+Alt + right click, or a key - set it up in Map > Mouse. Windows and Mac. FL Studio: a plugin from the ring or a card goes on the track you selected, also when another window lies over the Mixer. Your settings are safe on every update: a copy is kept every day, a damaged file comes back by itself, and an older copy of the app never writes over newer settings. 0.9.29 - Studio One / Studio Pro: instrument cards now drop straight onto the arrangement and make a new instrument track with the instrument loaded (on the empty area or on a track), and so do VST3 presets of instruments. Effects drop onto tracks as before. 0.9.28 - Mac: the strip key puts you in the search every time, also after you load a plugin and go back to your DAW (it used to work once, then needed a click). "Closes by itself after a plugin loads" closes the strip again instead of bringing it back. 0.9.27 - Mac keyboard: shortcuts can use Cmd, and every key shows as ⌘ ⌥ ⌃ ⇧ (Setup and the Map keyboard). 0.9.26 - The strip key now goes straight into the search on Mac too: press it and type, no click needed (also when the strip was left open behind your DAW). Bitwig: plugins, MIDI files and actions now really load onto the selected track - Bitwig used to drop them silently. Add the controller once in Bitwig: Settings > Controllers > Add controller > RONE > RONE VST Manager.

tips.text: End the bar with a Throw: automate THROW up on the last beat only, on a dry sound, and let the tail carry the transition.

i18n.pt: Termine o compasso com um Throw: automatize o THROW só no último tempo, num som seco, e deixe a cauda levar a transição.
i18n.es: Cierra el compás con un Throw: automatiza THROW solo en el último tiempo, sobre un sonido seco, y deja que la cola lleve la transición.

tips.text: Draw the Stucker knob up exactly on the hit you want caught: it grabs what starts where the knob comes up, every time.

i18n.pt: Desenhe o knob do Stucker subindo exatamente no hit que você quer capturar: ele pega o que começa onde o knob sobe, sempre.
i18n.es: Dibuja el knob de Stucker subiendo justo en el golpe que quieres atrapar: atrapa lo que empieza donde sube el knob, siempre.

tips.text: Turn Rise up over the last 8 bars and snap it to zero on the drop: the reverb still spills into the first hit.

i18n.pt: Suba o Rise nos últimos 8 compassos e zere no drop: o reverb ainda transborda no primeiro hit.
i18n.es: Sube Rise en los últimos 8 compases y llévalo a cero en el drop: la reverb aún se derrama en el primer golpe.

tips.text: Turn LOW CUT up so the kick and bass stay out of the clipper, then push CLIP until the blue only touches the transients.

i18n.pt: Suba o LOW CUT para o kick e o baixo ficarem fora do clipper, depois empurre o CLIP até o azul só tocar os transientes.
i18n.es: Sube LOW CUT para que el kick y el bajo queden fuera del clipper, luego empuja CLIP hasta que el azul solo toque los transitorios.

tips.text: Put Reverse Reverb on the last word before the drop: the swell runs straight into the hit, with no gap.

i18n.pt: Coloque o Reverse Reverb na última palavra antes do drop: o swell entra direto no hit, sem buraco.
i18n.es: Pon Reverse Reverb en la última palabra antes del drop: el swell entra directo en el golpe, sin hueco.

tips.text: INFINITE at 32 BAR gives a rise that never stops climbing: automate MIX up over the build.

i18n.pt: O INFINITE em 32 BAR dá um rise que nunca para de subir: automatize o MIX ao longo do build.
i18n.es: INFINITE en 32 BAR da un rise que nunca deja de subir: automatiza MIX a lo largo del build.
